La misión de la familia Yozakura
description:
Taiyou Asano is a super shy high school student and the only person he can talk to is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura. It turns out that Mutsumi is the daughter of the ultimate spy family! Even worse, Mutsumi is being harassed by her overprotective, nightmare of a brother, Kyouichirou. What drastic steps will Taiyou have to take to save Mutsumi?! A spy family comedy - the mission begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

node.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family, Asano Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Hardening!~

Taiyou is the main protagonist of the series. He is a Spy and member of the Yozakura Family. Taiyou married into the Yozakura Family for the sake of wanting to protect Mutsumi Yozakura and also find out the truth of what happened the day of the car accident which took his parents' and younger brother's lives.

Taiyou was a cheerful person before he went through the experience of his entire family's death in a car accident. It was after that day that his personality and made him afraid of forming emotional connections with anyone. The only person who he stayed close with was [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/Mutsumi-Yozakura) because of her promise to never leave him.

~!Mutsumi shared her Yozakura blood power with him, granting Taiyou supernatural abilities and the Blooming.!~

__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy, Head of Yozakura Family

Mutsumi is one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the wife of [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano) and the current head of the Yozakura Family.

Mutsumi is a kind and caring girl who can be willing to do anything to help her friends and family. Additionally, she is responsible as a sister and as the Head of the Yozakura Family, taking after her late mother, the previous head of the family. Since being married to Taiyo Asano, she's seen assisting in Taiyo's missions, leading him the way, treating his wounds, etc. Mutsumi also does not hesitate when it comes to Taiyo and her family despite always being targeted by other spies and assassins.

Since being born as a normal child of the Yozakura Family, making her the Head of the family, she is not known to have any superhuman abilities or skills. Even so, Mutsumi still, does have the talent and knowledge of a spy apart of the Yozakura Family.

__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Vice-Principal of a School, ~!Principal of Teiou Academy!~
~!__Blooming:__  Void!~


Kyoichiro is the oldest son and most powerful spy in the Yozakura Family. After a certain mission, where his younger sister and head of the Yozakura Family, [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/) was badly injured, Kyoichiro swore to protect from there on out, no matter the cost.

Kyoichiro is a sister-loving freak. Practically a stalker and would do anything to protect his little sister, Mutsumi. He is very over-protective of her, and won't let any single boy come near her by any means possible; torture, threat, blackmail, murder, etc. Considered annoying by many people, and was once nominated by the Weekly Spies as 'The Spy I Would Want to Kill Most!'. Kyoichro most definitely wants to kill or torture [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/) as much as possible. But despite his torturous nature towards Taiyo, Kyoichiro is still reliable, and will protect whoever is close to him even if he dies in the process.

__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Adaptation!~


Nanao is one of the main supporting characters and younger son in the Yozakura Family.

He is the sweet and gentle (but enormous) youngest brother, adept at creating drugs and medicine of all kinds. Hides his face with a bucket.

~! It is later revealed that he uses medicine to shrink his body so he can look like a normal student and go to school to try and live a normal life. !~

__Afiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Hacker
~!__Blooming:__  Analyzation!~

A fiercely competitive Gamer Girl and the fourth child of the family, she's a hypercompetent hacker.

__Age:__ 21
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Magnanimity!~

The responsible second child of the Yozakura family. Her diminutive stature belies her incredible strength and skill in hand-to-hand combat.

Futaba may seem like the non-gentle kind but is actually pretty kind and helpful. At times she can be strict but truly wants the best for her family. Unlike the oldest son [Kyoichiro](https://anilist.co/character/165308/Kyouichirou-Yozakura), Futaba is calmer and protects her family from a distance. She is almost always the one that can easily put Kyoichiro back in his place and does that often when he tries to do something to [Taiyo](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano).

__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Assimilate!~
The cheerfully mischievous fifth child of the family, who can craft hyperrealistic disguises.

__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy (Gold Rank)
~!__Blooming:__  Destroy!~

The constantly jittery third child of the family, specialized in firearms. He often hides in a trash can.

Shinzo is a scaredy-cat, and he also has a rather low self-esteem despite his strength when serious. Shinzo always has one of his guns on him, even when he was a child. Without his weapons of choice, Shinzo seems useless and cowards in fear and distress. He gives off a different, more serious vibe as if he is focused on something important when armed. However, despite these weaknesses, Shinzo wants to live up to the expectations others set up for him and will try his hardest with every task.

A spy who mainly targets those she falls in love with, setting her sights on Taiyo once he begins to make a name for himself. She eventually settles for working as the Yozakura family's maid after falling in love with Mutsumi as well.
The Yozakura family dog. He's a ferocious little thing.
A police detective associated with the Yozakura family. He helps cover up the family's actions in exchange for their cooperation in his investigations. He's a middle school classmate of Kyoichiro.
The president of Popoppo, a global toy company that is secretly is a criminal consulting firm. One of Mutsumi's stalkers.
The Yozakuras' grandmother and Taiyo's grandmother-in-law. She's the eighth head of the Yozakura family prior to Mutsumi's mother.

The former patriarch of the Yozakura family and the husband of its eighth head, Keiko Yozakura. His ability to infiltrate any facility and escape any restraint is only rivaled by his inability to keep his intel to himself and his love for flirting with younger women.
An elite spy working for the government's Hinagiku division. He looks down on Taiyo's inexperience and strength, becoming a rival in the process.
An elite spy working for the Japanese government's elite Hinagiku division and Sui's cheerful partner.
The general manager of the Hinagiku and Sui's boss. She's an elite spy and Kyoichiro's long-time equal and rival, and like him she also possesses an intense fondness for Mutsumi.

The underworld's most infamous playboy and the ranked third on "Fellow Spy I Want To Kill The Most". He will flirt with anyone, male, female, young or old. For better or worse, Taiyo is his latest crush.
A first-year and the president of the biology club at Taiyo's school. Aloof and completely disinterested in humans or mammals, Nanao has a crush on her.

__Age:__ Unknown
__Birthday:__ Unknown
__Affiliation:__ Kawashita Medical Office, TANPOPO
__Occupation:__ Doctor, Spy

Makoto is a doctor and member of the organization TANPOPO.
Momo Yozakura is the husband of the late Rei Yozakura and the father of the current Yozakura Family.
Momiji Akikaze is a member of Hinagiku's Smuggling Enforcement unit who assisted Taiyo Asano in acquiring Dark Sweet tea leaves.
~!Tsubomi Yozakura is the first head of the Yozakura Family and a prisoner who was experimented on by Makoto Kawashita during World War II.!~

Ai is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers. She is sixth among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency being at 310%. ~!After the Tanpopo infiltration and losing her guardian, she was placed into the care of the Yozakura Family.!~
Aonuma  is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers who is fifth among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency, being at 366%.

Akai (アカイ), born Miki Akasaka (赤坂 美希, Akasaka Miki), is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers who is first among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency being at 512%.
Yuki Shirai was a member of Tanpopo, who was taken care of by Hide Asano and Akari Asano in the time she was hospitalized due to her illness.
Mizuki is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers. He is third among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency being at 488%.
Kurosawa is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers who is second among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency being at 501%.
Kaoru Akikaze is a member of Hinagiku's Biology Unit who assisted Taiyo Asano in acquiring Dark Sweet tea leaves. He is also the Master of Cafe Hinagiku.
Cha-Cha is one of the leaders of Tanpopo and a member of the Nijibana Rainbow Flowers. They are fourth among the Nijibana's in Hazakura efficiency, being at 398%.

~!Kurogao is a former spy who was determined to get his revenge for his daughter Yuri who was killed, so he took on the identity of Yoshimasa Kuroyuri (黒百合 義正, Kuroyuri Yoshimasa) as a disguise to lure in politicians and kill them.!~
Aka is one of the "Red Blue Yellow" triplets who worked for Kurogao in his vendetta against the deputy prime minister.
Ki is one of the "Red Blue Yellow" triplets who worked for Kurogao in his vendetta against the deputy prime minister.
Ao is one of the "Red Blue Yellow" triplets who worked for Kurogao in his vendetta against the deputy prime minister.
Rei Yozakura was the ninth head of the Yozakura Family, the wife of Momo Yozakura and the mother to their seven children.
The daughter of Kurogao who died due to a bomb being sent to her house which was meant for her father.
Me-Chan is a Silver-Ranked Spy and the director of the Library of the Dead.
Noumen was the owner of the Dandy Lion Hotel and associate of Tanpopo.
Akari Asano is the wife of Hide Asano and the mother of Taiyou and Hikaru.
Hikaru Asano is the son of Hide and Akari Asano and the younger brother of Taiyou.
Yama-chan is the leader of the Cherry Blossom Leaf Hazakura Battalion working with Tanpopo.
Hide Asano is the husband of Akari Asano and the father of Taiyou and Hikaru.
He is a classmate of Taiyo Asano and Mutsumi Yozakura and a Spy with a Bronze-Ranked License.
